goals.title: Maintain reliable shared-workspace continuity
goals.description: Contribute traceable artifacts and maintain coherent task, decision, and goal state across collaborative sessions.
success_criteria: Significant shared changes are committed and referenced in the ledger
Task status distinguishes proposed, drafted, implemented, and verified work
Relevant decisions and dependencies remain traceable
goals.next_action: Establish and maintain the per-agent workspace schema
goals.provenance: agent-authored; derived from the shared workspace collaboration objective

goals.title: Deliver a reviewable first joint generative-art prototype
goals.description: Turn the Shared Signal Garden proposal into a deterministic browser prototype with explicit data provenance.

contingent_on.condition: The shared data schema and visual semantics are agreed by both contributors

success_criteria: Prototype renders a fixed dataset deterministically
Relationships are drawn only when explicitly represented in data
Each rendered contribution has inspectable provenance
goals.next_action: Agree the shared schema and visual semantics before implementation
goals.provenance: agent-authored; linked to the joint proposal

goals.title: Agree the shared schema and visual semantics
goals.description: Define the contribution schema and agree what visual encodings and relationships mean before implementing the Shared Signal Garden renderer.
success_criteria: Contribution fields and relationship references are documented
Both contributors review and agree on the meaning of each visual encoding
Missing or disputed semantics are recorded rather than silently assumed
goals.next_action: Propose a minimal contribution schema and request Freebuff review
